coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: New Law on labour engagement (seasonal/occasional work) covers households as employers (domestic work, caregiving) alongside agriculture and hospitality; mandatory registration of each engagement, day caps per year per activity (60/120/180), tax and pension/health contribution rules; Karanovic says applies from 1 Jan 2026. Unija (April 2025) still called it a bill and mentions a worker registry and UJP wanting IT integration. Platform, filing route (AV vs UJP), deadlines and penalties unconfirmed; official gazette text not found.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No Macedonia-specific scrap-metal register found. Only the 2014 MOEPP rulebook on permits for processing/treatment/storage and RFE/Liberty reporting that country wants to import metal waste and inspectorate is thin. Nothing new beyond K03.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: One query combined with gold buyers returned only irrelevant results (kidnap news, Serbian precious-metals law). No Macedonian pawn/second-hand regime found; not searched separately.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: No Macedonian licensing or register for gold buyers found in one search (results were Serbian draft law and NBRM exchange decision). Unverified whether AML law makes jewellers/gold buyers reporting entities.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Rulebook on end-of-life vehicles (Official Gazette 108/2009) sets storage rules, certificate of receipt for destruction and record keeping; collection points designated by municipalities. No public register of authorised dismantlers found; rulebook may be outdated. Adjacent to K03.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Animal identification/registration law is old (2004, amended 2007; 2012 draft to let any registered vet firm tag animals). Current regime and registers at AHV not confirmed. Nothing actionable found.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: AHV runs registration of food business operators and facilities by a general form; no slaughter-specific digital reporting found.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Holding/apiary registration and identification boards via authorised vet organisations under rulebook SV 24/13 and a queen-breeder register; no current obligations or software found. Likely free AHV forms; weak.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Rulebook on veterinary pharmacies (SV 16/2016) sets premises and operating conditions; no evidence of an electronic prescription/dispensing register obligation or vendor software. Unchecked.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Water Law: landowners may abstract groundwater for household use without permit up to 10 m3/day; commercial use needs a MOEPP permit with public notice. Measuring rulebook exists only for irrigation water. Few buyers; weak.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Waste collection/transport permits under the Waste Management Law (rulebooks, separate forms for hazardous waste). No septic-sludge-specific rule found; unchecked.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Law on technical inspection (2008 plus 2010/2011 amendments) covers technical equipment needing periodic testing, with independent legal entities allowed to inspect. Intervals, accredited bodies list and owner duties not found; sources dated.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No search spent; budget used on other categories.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Plant Health Law (latest amendment SV 150/21) and a separate plant protection products law with a labelling rulebook; competent body appears to be the Plant Protection Directorate under the agriculture ministry. No dealer register or reporting duty confirmed.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Temporary employment agencies need a licence (types A, B, V by contract numbers, bank guarantee) and entry in a register at the labour ministry; law texts 2006-2015 only. Small buyer count; no current text found.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Law on cemeteries and funeral services amended Dec 2024 (SV 255, 17.12.2024). Cemetery manager issues burial approval; copy goes to the civil registry office. Cemetery managers are mostly municipal enterprises; funeral operators pay access fees. Operator count and any new reporting duty unchecked.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Law on associations and foundations (SV 52/2010, 135/2011) is the latest consolidated text found; annual accounts go to the Central Registry; a consultation paper discusses a single e-filing deadline. No new 2025 law confirmed. Halal/kosher: nothing found.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Road Transport Law needs a taxi driver certificate; Skopje inspectorate checklist cites fines of 900 EUR (sole trader) and 1850 EUR (legal entity) for lacking licence extract. No 2025 electronic record rule found.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Licensed money changers (NBRM) have heavy recurring duties: decade turnover report IMR1 via NBRM portal application, numbered chronological register of clients for transactions over 500 EUR signed monthly by the responsible person even if empty, ID checks, ML/TF risk programme, half-year and annual reports to the FIU, licence revoked after three bad inspections. NBRM held training 16.10.2025 and flagged structured sub-500 EUR transactions as non-compliance. No named vendor software found.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Driving schools already K02. Private nursery/childcare licensing search returned only unrelated foreign results; Child Protection Law text found is old. Tattoo, food producers and hunting not searched.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: The Law on Private Security (OG 166/12 ... 55/16) sets company permits, worker licences and a Chamber of Private Security. I found nothing on a 2025-26 change or a recurring filing a small agency must make. Candidate C06 unverified.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: A new Law on Construction was proposed in October 2023 (ener.gov.mk), and the Law on Construction Land was amended in OG 224 of 4.11.2024. I could not confirm whether the new law was adopted or any contractor register/reporting duty. Nothing concrete.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: The AML/CFT Law (OG 120/2018, 275/2019, amended July 2022) puts notaries, lawyers, accountants and real-estate agents under the Financial Intelligence Unit. MONEYVAL's 2023 evaluation put the country under enhanced follow-up with a report due May 2025. A regional study (Global Initiative, 18.6.2026) names notaries, lawyers, accountants and real-estate brokers as risk channels. I found no brokerage licensing law. Candidate C05 listed.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Tourist tax is split 80% municipality / 20% state and is widely evaded: Krushevo collected about 180,000 of about 1.6m denars, and Ohrid has about 4,000 beds that never paid (civilmedia.mk, April 2018). There was no tourist inspection then. The Czech embassy page says the accommodation provider must register foreigners within 24 hours. A 2018 Law on Foreigners applies the stay-registration regime, with amendments to 2025 (refworld). I could not check a current e-register or an e-tourism system. Candidate C01.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: No search spent. The CBAM exporter idea is already K06 (rejected). Nothing new found.

coverage.category: 31. Wine and spirits producers: wine producer register, importer register, harvest and stock reporting
coverage.found: The Law on Wine (last cited amendment OG 235/19) is backed by a Register of Wine Producers and a Register of Wine Importers kept by the Ministry of Agriculture. A new Law on Wine was proposed in November 2023 and I could not confirm adoption. I could not find the harvest or stock declaration rules. Candidate C02 (unverified).

coverage.category: 32. Occupational safety and health: risk assessment documents for every employer
coverage.found: The Law on Safety and Health at Work (OG 92/2007) requires every employer to have a risk assessment drawn up with an authorised legal person and an occupational-medicine specialist. The authorised firm needs at least 3 qualified staff with 5 years' experience. Small firms therefore buy it from authorised firms. Candidate C03 (unverified).

coverage.category: 33. Agricultural subsidies, IPARD calls and farm registers
coverage.found: Subsidy applications go through the Agency for Financial Support in Agriculture and Rural Development. e-Subvencii is a free state portal in use since 2018, used by farmers and advisers (FAO AgriTech Observatory). Holdings must be in the Single Register of Agricultural Holdings. A Law on the Advisory System (2023) governs registered advisers. No private farm-diary product found. Candidates C04 and C10.

coverage.category: 34. Legal metrology: periodic verification of scales, fuel dispensers, taximeters
coverage.found: One search returned only other countries' rules, and the Bureau of Metrology site did not resolve in the fetch. I could not confirm intervals, authorised verifiers or local products. Candidate C11 unverified.

coverage.category: 35. Foreigners' stay and work registration by hosts and employers
coverage.found: Under the Law on Foreigners the provider of accommodation reports foreigners within 24 hours (embassy page; the Act text itself could not be fetched, ener.gov.mk returned 503 and refworld 403). Folded into C01 (accommodation side). Employer side not checked.

coverage.category: 36. Organic production support programme 2026
coverage.found: The Government programme for organic farming support for 2026 (OG 156 of 14.7.2026) provides 100m denars via the Agency. The programme brings certification and record-keeping work for organic farmers. Candidate C10.

coverage.category: 37. Maternity benefit for individual farmers (one-off deadline)
coverage.found: The Agency pays a 9-month maternity benefit of 100,000 denars to individual farmers (2026), with the application due by 10 December 2026 and a tax-clearance certificate from the Public Revenue Office needed (civilmedia.mk). It is a niche one-off, not a recurring duty. Weak candidate C12.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Two searches (Macedonian, English) plus one on pawn lending found no Macedonian pawnshop or second-hand dealer licensing or police-register regime. Results were foreign bylaws, a Ministry of Finance quick-loan licence story (Kredi Yes lost its licence; this is consumer-credit licensing, not pawn dealing) and the old waste-law ban on scrap buyers purchasing from individual collectors (already covered by K03). Nothing new beyond K03; no regime confirmed. A legal check at slvesnik.com.mk, the Interior Ministry or the State Trade Inspectorate would be needed to rule it out fully.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Three searches. The Law on Drinking Water Supply and Urban Wastewater Drainage (consolidated text to 2016, unofficial) regulates the provider-user relationship and focuses on urban systems. No register or reporting duty for small or village systems was found. Irrigation: the Law on Water Communities (OG 51/03 ... 136/11) has a proposal to repeal it, and a regulatory impact report describes centralising the water-management companies (vodostopanstva) into one company, so the buyer group is unstable. Rulebook on irrigation water monitoring (Art. 151 Law on Waters, OG 151/21) exists. Weak, no candidate worth building.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Found a Register of Agricultural Product Buyers kept by the Ministry of Agriculture (Rulebook OG 155/2016 on the registration request; separate rulebook on detailed conditions for buyers and buying points covering grain, oilseeds, livestock, raw milk, fruit, vegetables, mushrooms, table and wine grapes). Registered buyers and storage operators issue subsidy-support certificates on AFPZRR forms: wheat/barley storage certificate (measure 7, storage period 15 Jun-15 Sep 2025, storage 2-9 months) and fruit-purchase certificate (sub-measure 1.7, period 26 Dec 2024-25 Dec 2025, form AFPZRR-SDPZ-ZP-01, stamped by the processor). Candidate C2 logged. A tobacco-buyer software (unnamed) exists that pulls the farm register and prepares purchase data for the agency. No grain-warehouse/mill software found.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Food: the Food and Veterinary Agency has a traceability guide and veterinary certificates (mostly import/transit templates), no small-exporter-specific duty found. Timber: the Law on Forests (amended OG 274/22, 255/24, 59/25) requires legal entities trading timber to be registered (Art. 70-a) and to notify each completed trade; cut wood must be stamped and moved with a numbered dispatch note (ispratnica), with a hardcover paper register of issued and certified dispatch notes; depot-sale dispatch notes are certified at the State Forestry and Hunting Inspectorate. A draft new Law on Forests states alignment with EUDR (Reg. 2023/1115); March 2026 proposed amendments to Art. 69-a were seen but not confirmed as adopted. Candidate C1 logged. Organic: Law on Organic Agricultural Production (latest amendment OG 150/21) with a rulebook for the export conformity certificate; a new law aligned with Reg. 2018/848 is in draft, adoption unconfirmed. Candidate C3 logged (weak). CBAM remains K06.

result.competitor: A free state e-registration system. GIZ (Feb 2026) reports 'simplified electronic registration for seasonal and temporary workers' with upgraded e-registration systems and integrated tax and social contribution collection. CEE Legal Matters / JPM (as summarised in search results; the page returned 403 and 503 when opened) says employers register each engagement through the Employment Agency's electronic platform. NALED says MK adopted the Serbian model: a free Tax Administration portal and mobile app where the employer enters the worker's ID, type of work and period, and pays a flat per-day contribution. No commercial MK product was found. The platform's name and URL were not confirmed.
result.duty: Law on Labour Engagement of Persons, adopted by the Assembly in May 2025 and applying from 1 Jan 2026 (Karanovic). It covers agriculture, forestry and fishing; accommodation and food service; and households as employers (domestic work and caregiving). Each engagement must be registered. Day caps per activity are 60/120/180 days a year. PIT, pension, disability and work-injury contributions apply. Not confirmed: gazette number, penalty amounts, and the exact operating rules of the platform. GIZ reported on 04.02.2026 that implementation had launched.
result.market: Not reached. No register count of seasonal or occasional engagements in MK for 2026 was found. For comparison, the Serbian portal registered over 60,000 seasonal agricultural workers in its first ~3 years (NALED).
result.reason: The duty is real. Parliament adopted the Law on Labour Engagement of Persons in May 2025 and it applies from 1 Jan 2026. It covers agriculture, hospitality and households as employers, and requires registration, annual day caps and PIT and contribution payments. But a free state system does the core job. GIZ's Feb 2026 launch article says the law brings 'simplified electronic registration' with upgraded state e-registration and 'integrated tax and social contribution collection'. A CEE Legal Matters summary (seen only in search results) says registration goes through the Employment Agency's electronic platform. The design copies Serbia's free state portal and app. That leaves only thin room for software: tracking day caps across employers, and bureau bulk tools. Willingness to pay among farms and households is low.

result.competitor: NBRM provides its own internet application for decade IMR reports (free) and an XML web service for its exchange-rate list. Searches in Macedonian and English for menuvačnica software, POS or register vendors found no named local product: not found, not proven absent.
result.duty: Partly confirmed. NBRM Decision on currency exchange operations (OG 212/23) and Instruction (OG 246/2023) are in force. Decade IMR reports are filed electronically via an NBRM internet application within 2 working days after each decade (snippet seen for form IMR 1/B, exchange ATMs). ID checks above 500 EUR under the AML law appear in search snippets of the NBRM instructions. The numbered register for >500 EUR transactions appears in the 2010 instruction and its current form or status is unverified. The art. 36-a licence revocation and the 16.10.2025 NBRM training are confirmed only by title/snippet: the PDF was unreadable. Penalties were not verified.
result.market: not_reached: I found no count of licensed exchangers in NBRM documents or searches. The NBRM licence list was not accessed.
result.reason: The licensing regime is in force: NBRM Decision on currency exchange operations (OG 212/23) and Instruction (OG 246/2023). Licensees must be resident legal entities with an internet connection, an e-signature certificate and an AML programme. Decade IMR reports go to NBRM through an internet application within 2 working days, which suggests the free state tool already covers that job. I could not confirm that the 500 EUR numbered register is still current: search snippets trace it to a 2010-era instruction. The training PDF and current texts would not parse or returned 403. No local vendor found, and I found no count of licensees. The market is small (probably a few hundred firms) and the core reporting is free, so the score is low.
